enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Place arm under pillow. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Turn to back. Stretch arms. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket over shoulder. Remain still. Breathe deeply.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and cereal. Close refrigerator. Take out bowl and spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up and place bowl in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to Bedroom 1. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Walk out of Bedroom 1.

Walk out of house. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit on seat. Look out window. Put on earphones. Listen to music. Check phone. Stand up. Walk to bus door. Exit bus. Walk to workplace.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workplace. Greet colleagues. Walk to locker room. Put on scrubs. Walk to nurse station. Check patient list. Pick up stethoscope. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check patient's vital signs. Record vital signs. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Walk to next patient room. Repeat procedures. Use computer to update records. Attend meeting. Walk to break room.

Walk to cafeteria. Stand in line. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Check phone. Stand up. Return tray. Walk to restroom. Wash hands. Walk back to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Check patient's condition. Adjust IV drip. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Write notes. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to nurse station. Answer phone. Talk to doctor. Use computer. Walk to patient room. Help patient walk. Change bandage. Walk to break room. Drink water. Walk back to work area. Attend training. Walk to locker room.
Walk to bus stop. Wait at bus stop. Check phone. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Check phone. Stand up. Walk to bus door. Exit bus. Walk home. Open door. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board and knife. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil to pan. Add vegetables and meat to pan. Stir with spatula. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner with fork. Drink water. Stand up and clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV or using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on light. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Check email. Browse internet. Watch video. Put down laptop. Pick up phone. Check social media. Continue watching TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body with soap. Wash hair with shampoo. Rinse body and hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body and hair. Put on pajamas. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Walk into Bedroom 1. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up to chin. Remain still. Breathe deeply.
